## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest behavioral change made.

## Verification

- [ ] Full test suite passes from a clean checkout.
- [ ] No credentials, account data, runtime databases, or private logs are included.
- [ ] Strategy behavior changes use a new version and preserve prior evidence.
- [ ] Profitability or edge claims are supported separately from software tests.

## Risk

Describe execution, attribution, protection, reconciliation, and migration risks.
